masthead.title: The Sunglasses Scientist
masthead.oneLinePremise: An eight-year-old in sunglasses insists he is a scientist, and his whole family has to play along.

cast.name: Shaz
cast.physicalDescription: Small round-faced boy, short black hair, red plastic sunglasses pushed up on his forehead, plain red t-shirt.
cast.signatureAccent: red plastic sunglasses pushed up on his forehead
cast.voiceDescription: Eight-year-old boy, flat declarative delivery, total conviction, quick pace.

cast.name: Mom
cast.physicalDescription: Kind round face, soft blue hijab fully covering hair and hairline, long modest dress.
cast.voiceDescription: Warm adult woman, gentle teasing tone, slow pace, quiet laugh.

cast.name: Sister
cast.physicalDescription: Young woman, grey hijab fully covering hair and hairline, oversized hoodie.
cast.voiceDescription: Eighteen-year-old, dry deadpan delivery, unimpressed, clipped lines.
cast.ageNote: true age 15 (7 years older than Shaz at 8); shown as 18

segments.title: Part 1: Original
segments.goalSummary: Ordinary afternoon card battle; Shaz declares himself a scientist twice, the third time Mom believes him. Six shots.
continuityLocks: Shaz screen-left, Sister screen-right at the kitchen table

shots.whatWeSee: @Shaz slaps a card down across the kitchen table from @Sister.
@Shaz pushes his sunglasses higher up his forehead very slowly.

shots.directorsNote: Play it completely straight; it is the ruler for the third beat.

shots.whatWeSee: @Shaz taps his sunglasses up on his forehead and slaps a second card.
@Mom appears in the doorway holding a tea towel, watching.
shots.whatWeHear: No dialogue in this shot; kettle starts to whistle.

shots.whatWeSee: @Mom nods seriously, holding back a smile, breathing.

segments.title: Part 2: Sequel
segments.goalSummary: Payoff: the sunglasses stay on; the narrator lands the memory. Three shots.

shots.whatWeSee: @Shaz marches to the window holding a cup of water like a beaker.
@Sister pushes a pair of sunglasses up onto her forehead too.
shots.whatWeHear: No dialogue in this shot; chair creak.

narration.speaker: @Shaz
narration.line: {Good people can still do bad things.}

shots.whatWeSee: Held image: the three of them in afternoon light, slow breathing, sunglasses glinting on foreheads.
